finding: Test-S5Release cannot complete: each of its two clean builds runs the full GameTest suite, which exceeds the script's 60-minute per-build timeout, so verifyReleaseArtifacts never executes
howItSurfaced: Step 5 was started at 11:45:21 and by 12:26 had produced only build-a/inputs.json - no stdout.log, which the script writes once a build finishes. A GameTest JVM, PID 27132, had been running since 11:45:43.

theMechanism.buildDependsOnRunGameTest: gradlew clean build verifyReleaseArtifacts --dry-run lists 33 tasks, and :runGameTest sits between :remapJar and :check. So build pulls it in.
theMechanism.why: build.gradle line 70 sets enableGameTests = true inside the runs block, so Loom wires the GameTest run into check, and build depends on check.

theConsequence.theTimeoutKillsIt: The script kills a build after 60 minutes and records timedOut true.
theConsequence.soTheGateNeverRuns: verifyReleaseArtifacts is the last task, after build, so it never executes - and its report file build/release/verifyReleaseArtifacts.json is therefore never written either.
theConsequence.andItWouldHappenTwice: Both build-a and build-b follow the same path, so the script would spend two hours and produce neither a gate report nor a SHA comparison.

whyTheJarsAppearedQuickly: remapJar runs before runGameTest, so build/libs was populated 22 seconds in. That made the build look fast while the expensive task had not yet started - which is why the round-238 note about a 22-second clean build was wrong.
whatIStopped: Killed the job rather than wait two hours for a known outcome. All four child processes exited cleanly, including the GameTest JVM.
whatStillStandsFromTheRun: build-a/inputs.json records the exact command and source commit 15c8b2b, and confirms networkUsed false with the offline flags.
correctionToRound238: Round 238 recorded that a clean build takes about 22 seconds, answering the round-213 timing question. That was wrong: 22 seconds is remapJar, not the build. The question remains open, and a clean build in this project includes a full GameTest run.
